_comment: Deterministic source of truth for the stack-lock gate checks (gates/lib/stack-lock.lib.sh, run by backend-gate.sh / frontend-gate.sh). This is the machine-readable form of the prose in rules/stacks/*.rules.md. 'forbidden' = dependencies that MUST NOT appear in a layer's package.json (wrong-stack drift); 'required' = dependencies that MUST be present. Keyed by the stack submodule name from PIPELINE_STATUS.md tech_stack (backend / frontends[0]). The gate logic stays generic — to change enforcement, edit ONLY this list, never the gate. An unlisted stack key is a no-op (checks pass), so other stacks are never falsely failed.
